metadata.title: On infinite knot families with the same HOMFLYPT polynomial
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we focus on the examples constructed by Kanenobu and provide new family knots with the same HOMFLYPT polynomial invariants, which are distinguished by the Kauffman polynomial.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 同 HOMFLYPT 的结族构造
analysis.workSummary: 围绕 Kanenobu 的例子构造具有相同 HOMFLYPT 多项式的新结族，并用 Kauffman 多项式区分其中的结。
techniques: HOMFLYPT 与 Kauffman 多项式比较
analysis.breakthrough: 增加 HOMFLYPT 多项式不能区分、但 Kauffman 多项式可以区分的结族。
analysis.limitations: 结论是特定结族的区别，不意味着任意同 HOMFLYPT 结都可由 Kauffman 多项式区分。
analysis.priorityReason: 展示两类经典结多项式的区分能力差异。
